title: Share of wild condor deaths from lead poisoning

source.name: California condor recovery program status reports

notes: Condor recovery programs have repeatedly reported lead poisoning, mainly from scavenging carcasses shot with lead ammunition, as the single leading cause of death among wild condors with a known cause -- roughly half of documented cases. Approximate share, recalled from training knowledge, not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
